The club's home ground is [[Kuressaare linnastaadion]]. Founded on 14 March 1997, the club competes in the [[Meistriliiga]], the top tier of [[Estonian football league system|Estonian football]]. Kuressaare debuted in the Estonian top division in 2000 and were known as a [[yo-yo club]] throughout the first decade of the 21st century, as they were promoted and relegated for eight consecutive seasons. Since then, the club has played in the Meistriliiga in 2009–2013 and again since 2018."}}
